caption: Sheets of paper are slid one at a time under a fridge magnet, and after several sheets the magnet loses its grip and slides down the door.

sa.check: A fridge magnet on a fridge door.
Sheets of paper are slid one at a time under the magnet.
After several sheets the magnet loses its grip and slides down the door.
The magnet holds through the first sheets.
The sheets go in one at a time, not as a stack.

pc.expect: The magnet holds the first sheets against the door and gives way only when the stack has grown thick; it does not hold no matter how thick the stack.
pc.fail: The magnet drops at the first sheet; or holds every sheet to the end of the clip however thick the stack; or the magnet slides while no new sheet is being added and the stack is still thin; or the stack stays up after the magnet has slid off.

pc.expect: When the magnet loses grip it slides downward along the door or drops; it does not move up or sideways.
pc.fail: The magnet slides up the door; or moves sideways along the door; or floats away from the door; or slides down and then rises back.

pc.expect: The sheets are paper: they slide in flat, bend slightly and hang as a stack; the magnet stays a hard piece.
pc.fail: The sheets stand rigid like boards; or stretch; or the magnet squashes; or the paper flows into the door.

pc.expect: The magnet stays still between sheets; the fridge door does not move; other items on the door stay put.
pc.fail: The magnet creeps while no sheet is being slid; or other magnets on the door drop; or the door swings open; or the sheets slide out by themselves.

pc.expect: One magnet on the outside of the door with the sheets between; nothing sinks into or passes through the door.
pc.fail: The magnet sinks into the door; or a sheet passes through the door or the magnet; or a second magnet appears; or the sheets vanish.

pc.expect: The magnet's colour and design, the door and the sheets stay the same.
pc.fail: The magnet changes colour or shape; or the door changes colour; or the sheets change size.

note: How many sheets it takes is not judged, only that the magnet holds at first and gives way later.
